summary: Example Ansible Builder version 3 definition with build_arg_defaults, galaxy, python and bindep dependencies, an ee-minimal-rhel8 base_image, additional_build_files and prepend/append build steps; the version defaults to 1 if not set.
questions: How do I copy ansible.cfg into an execution environment build?
How do I set the base image for an execution environment?
What is the default ansible-builder schema version?

answer_card.title: Execution environment definition (v3)
answer_card.answer_md:
```
version: 3
build_arg_defaults:
  ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CLI_COLLECTION_OPTS: '--pre'
dependencies:
  galaxy: requirements.yml
  python:
    - six
    - psutil
  system: bindep.txt
images:
  base_image:
    name: registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-24/ee-minimal-rhel8:latest
additional_build_files:
  - src: files/ansible.cfg
    dest: configs
additional_build_steps:
  prepend_galaxy:
    - ADD _build/configs/ansible.cfg /home/runner/.ansible.cfg
  append_final:
    - RUN ls -la /etc
```

Always set `version: 3`; it defaults to 1.
